snippet.title: Beat "Abu Khammas" in 4 minutes!  ( Arabic Super Mario)
snippet.description:
Abu Khammas Games was created on 2003 and become very famous. After more than 14 years, We would like to present for you the walkthrough the game and end all levels to meet Umm Khammas!
